propositions: Git failure strings are classified at five distinct sites with conflicting verdicts for identical error text, requiring centralization into one marker registry keyed by operation.
The synthetic rc-124 timeout result is constructed at four locations with different retry semantics, needing consolidation into one shared run_git_bounded construction.

The marker string 'cannot lock ref' must preserve three deliberately different verdicts (retriable local lock, non-CAS push reject, terminal advisory lock held) across operations, not collapsed into one.
Transient filesystem faults in sync._union_merge and push_recovery merges are not retried despite being retriable elsewhere, requiring shared retry logic.
A tenth classification kind INVALID_OBJECT (index entry references missing object DB entry) must remain distinct from FATAL to preserve its index-rebuild-then-retry recovery action.
Guard constraints must statically verify marker strings appear only in git_outcome.py and synthetic timeout construction only in gitutil.py, with operator-exempt escape hatches for legitimate uses.
